title: US-short §13.1 calibration-item registry + §13.2 reminder-threshold priors — const-pins the stable-numbered lifecycle item set that the reminder mechanism (us_short_lifecycle_eval) must traverse
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract. Freezes the §13.1 待校准清单 (stable-numbered items, '编号稳定，正文按号引用') so every '§13 #N' cross-reference in the design, every field-registry lifecycle_item_id (§10), and every sibling governance schema's *_calibration_item_id resolves to a real item; and pins the §13.2 default reminder-threshold priors + the §13 governing policy. item_count is the authoritative count; the eval must DERIVE its traversal from this registry, never hardcode the literal (§13 '动态、不硬编码条数'). draft-07 cannot express: contiguity (1..N no gap/dupe), schema==preset==design byte-faithful triangulation, '§13 #N' cross-ref integrity, and sibling *_calibration_item_id ∈ this set — all enforced in tests.

calibration_items.description: §13.1 待校准清单 — exact stable-numbered set AND order, const-pinned. number = stable key (referenced doc-wide by '§13 #N'); title = byte-faithful design text.
